newsitem.title: UK: NatWest Markets exec Riley joins CFSB.
newsitem.headline: NatWest Markets exec Riley joins CFSB.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston on Monday appointed Nick Riley as managing director and head of European operations in London.
Riley, 40, was most recently at NatWestMarkets, a unit of National Westminster Bank plc, where he was chief administrative officer at Global Financial Markets.

Riley is the latest of a number of NatWest Markets' employees who left the company to join CSFB. Last month, Grant Johnson, former syndication chief at NatWest Markets, and David Slade, former director of high yield finance and head of European Origination, joined CSFB.
Last week, NatWest announced a plan to restructure the beleaguered investment banking unit in the aftermath of its admission that it lost 90 million pounds on interest rate options trading.
CSFB is wholly owned by Zurich-based Credit Suisse Group.
